bio.en: I work on time-series foundation models (TSPulse), edge AI, and explainability for autonomous systems at IRIT (Université Toulouse Capitole) and TwinswHeel. My research focuses on adapting and distilling deep foundation models into lightweight, adaptive architectures for low-latency onboard anomaly detection.
bio.fr: Je travaille sur les modèles de fondation temporels (TSPulse), l'Edge AI et l'explicabilité pour les systèmes autonomes à l'IRIT (Université Toulouse Capitole) et chez TwinswHeel. Mes recherches portent sur l'adaptation et la distillation de modèles de fondation en architectures légères et adaptatives pour la détection d'anomalies embarquée à basse latence.

research.title: Foundation Models & Edge AI
research.description: Distilling and adapting deep time-series foundation models (TSPulse) for real-time edge anomaly detection.

research.title: Explainability (XAI)
research.description: Using SHAP contributions to analyze detector complementarity and ensure reliable decisions under domain shifts.

research.title: Time Series & Multi-Agents
research.description: Interactive and multi-agent ensemble learning for multivariate time series classification and fault detection.
